name: stagecoach
description: Lumiverse Spindle extension that steers a roleplay through a character card's greetings as ordered story stages.

scripts.build:backend: bun build src/backend.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm
scripts.build:frontend: bun build src/frontend.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm
scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
